concerns.location: tasks.md:T004 (and coverage table) vs constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: Constitution VI requires 'Training and inference time, plus peak RAM usage, MUST be recorded for each UQ technique evaluated.' T004 records only pipeline-level memory_peak_mb/total_duration_seconds in pipeline_run.json. No task produces per-technique (per method×dataset) cost records, so this constitution requirement has no implementing task.

NFR-003 requires 'All dependencies must be pinned in requirements.txt.' No task creates, verifies, or exercises code/requirements.txt (the plan's Project Structure lists it). The coverage table maps NFR-003 only to seeds/determinism, leaving the pinned-dependencies half uncovered.

The plan specifies an integration test at tests/integration/test_pipeline.py, but no task creates or runs it; T008 only runs 'pytest tests/' and T003/T005 reference unit tests. Either add a task for the integration test or note the plan element is dropped.

Plan elements 'results/summary.csv' (repo-root results/ dir) and 'code/main.py' entry point have no matching task — tasks write summary.csv to data/results/ and invoke only code/pipeline.py. If the plan layout is superseded, no task amends plan.md; an implementer following the plan produces artifacts the task verifiers won't find.
